description.en: Delete protection for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: every shell deletion is refused and redirected to a Recycle Bin tool, quoting typos that turn a path into a volume root are caught before dispatch, and platform-level deletions are recognised. Personal tool, not a guarantee.
description.zh-cn: Windows 上的 DSH 删除保护：所有 shell 删除被拒绝并重定向到回收站工具；把路径变成卷根的引号错误在执行前拦下；平台级删除同样识别。个人工具，不承诺绝对拦住。

title.en: Delete guard: recycle-bin only, quoting-typo safe
title.zh-cn: 删除闸门：只走回收站，挡住引号写错

description.en: Refuses every shell delete, redirects it to file_trash (Recycle Bin), catches the PowerShell/cmd quoting mistake that turned rmdir /s /q into a volume wipe, and recognises eleven platform-level delete families. Verified against ten 100k-line corpora and one AST-oracle round.
description.zh-cn: 拒绝一切 shell 删除并重定向到 file_trash（回收站）；抓住那个把 rmdir /s /q 变成整盘清空的 pwsh/cmd 引号错误；另识别 11 类平台级删除。经十轮各 10 万行语料与一轮 AST 对拍验证。
